origin: Original analytic pixel values authored for this Aura3D source test; no external image or engine asset was used.

referenceVerification.encoderReadback: OpenEXR 3.4.6 InputFile read every Y, RY, BY, A and root R sample after DWAB encoding. The generator reported a maximum absolute channel sample error of 0.00585938 against the authored values.
referenceVerification.header: exrheader 3.4.6 reported version 2, DWAB compression, the named channels and sampling, chromaticities and the data window.
referenceVerification.reproducibility: Two consecutive generator invocations produced the same SHA-256.
